t: The Fortress Trade Angled Timbercare Paint Brush 4.75" is a professional painting tool engineered for precise application on outdoor surfaces and in difficult-to-reach spaces. Featuring synthetic bristles with a flagged tip, this brush offers high paint load capacity for superior pick up and smooth release, significantly reducing tramlines. It is ideal for intricate timberwork, fencing, and detailed trim, providing a consistent, high-quality finish on every project. The comfortable ergonomic handle ensures prolonged use with less fatigue, and the brush is suitable for all paints and varnishes, plus quick and easy to clean.
